note: Locations of Lonesome Dove. Coordinates are scholarly estimates — McMurtry kept some geography deliberately loose. approx:true means the novel gives only a region, not a point.

locations.name: Lonesome Dove
locations.blurb: A dusty fictional hamlet on the Rio Grande: the Hat Creek Cattle Company and Livery Emporium, the Dry Bean saloon, and not much else. "We don't rent pigs."

locations.name: Pedro Flores's Ranch
locations.blurb: Across the river in Mexico — the Hat Creek outfit's longtime source of involuntary livestock. The herd that goes to Montana starts here, by moonlight.

locations.name: Nueces Crossing
locations.blurb: First river of the drive, and its first grave. Sean O'Brien rides into a nest of water moccasins. Jasper Fant never trusts water again.

locations.name: San Antonio
locations.blurb: A long-established city the herd passes on its way north. Lorena had lived there before Lonesome Dove; she refuses to enter it with Jake.

locations.name: The Live-Oak Grove on the South Guadalupe
locations.blurb: The little live-oak grove where young Gus and Clara picnicked. Gus asks to be buried there, and Call keeps the promise.

locations.name: Austin
locations.blurb: Jake gambles in Austin while Lorena waits at their camp west of town. Good cards keep him away longer than he intended.

locations.name: Jake and Lorena's Camp West of Austin
locations.blurb: A pool below a limestone bluff, roughly west of Austin. Jake leaves Lorena here while he gambles in town; Blue Duck takes her during the cattle stampede.

locations.name: Hat Creek Camp near Austin
locations.blurb: The Hat Creek camp west of Austin, roughly two miles west of Lorena's camp. Gus rides from here after Blue Duck, whose tracks are mixed with the stampede.

locations.name: Fort Worth
locations.blurb: Jake's next long gambling stop after Lorena's abduction, at Bill's Saloon on the Trinity River bluffs. The Hat Creek herd later camps west of town while Gus is still gone.

locations.name: The Storm Plain
locations.blurb: Open country in Oklahoma Territory, half a day south of the Canadian, where lightning kills thirteen cattle and Bill Spettle during a stampede.

locations.name: Red River Crossing
locations.blurb: Out of Texas and into the Indian Territory. The herd crosses on a gravel bar and through mud flats; Texas is behind them for good.

locations.name: Blue Duck's Camp on the Canadian
locations.blurb: At a fictional camp by the Canadian, Monkey John, Dog Face, and Ermoke's Kiowas hold Lorena after Blue Duck trades her. Gus and July charge the camp at night after Blue Duck has left.

locations.name: Roscoe's Camp on the Canadian
locations.blurb: The upriver camp where Roscoe, Joe, and Janey wait while Gus and July ride downriver. Blue Duck doubles back and kills all three before July returns.

locations.name: The Tent on the Canadian
locations.blurb: A separate camp near the Canadian where Gus shelters Lorena in a borrowed tent and trails the herd at a distance while she recovers.

locations.name: Fort Smith, Arkansas
locations.blurb: July Johnson's town: a stray shot from an old buffalo rifle Jake Spoon grabbed in a saloon killed Benny Johnson — dentist, mayor, and July's own brother — and set half the book in motion.

locations.name: The Arkansas River
locations.blurb: Elmira's escape route: a whiskey boat carrying buffalo hunters and traders upstream toward Bent's Fort, while Elmira follows the rumor of Dee Boot.

locations.name: Bent's Old Fort NHS
locations.blurb: The whiskey caravan's destination, anchored to Bent's Old Fort National Historic Site near La Junta in Otero County, Colorado. The marker remains approximate because, under this chart's conventional 1876 dating, the original trading post had long since closed; the place name is explicit, but its story-era referent is uncertain.

locations.name: The Hanging Ground
locations.blurb: By a steep-banked creek in western Kansas, near enough trees for four nooses: the three Suggs brothers and Jake Spoon.

locations.name: Wilbarger's Ambush
locations.blurb: West of Dodge near the Arkansas corridor, the Suggs gang shoots Wilbarger and his hands for their horses. The exact site is not recoverable from the novel.

locations.name: Dodge City
locations.blurb: The wicked cowtown everyone talks about and the drive carefully skirts. Jake never gets his hand of cards there.

locations.name: Ogallala, Nebraska
locations.blurb: Last real town before Montana. The boys get their first night on the town; an army scout quirts Newt and learns what Captain Call thinks of rude behavior.

locations.name: Clara's Horse Ranch
locations.blurb: Clara Allen's spread near the Platte, almost twenty miles from Ogallala: horses, daughters, a dying husband, and the strongest gravity in the novel. Lorena stays; July stays; Gus almost does.

locations.name: Deets's Grave
locations.blurb: Powder River country, Wyoming Territory. A salvaged plank, carved deep by Call: "Served with me 30 years... Splendid behaviour."

locations.name: Yellowstone Crossing
locations.blurb: The herd crosses after already entering Montana Territory. Po Campo dreads it; Jasper builds floats; all the cattle and stock get across safely.

locations.name: Miles City, Montana
locations.blurb: Rough army-and-hide town on the Yellowstone where a doctor takes Gus's left leg and asks for the right. Gus declines. "It's been quite a party, ain't it?"

locations.name: Hat Creek Ranch, Milk River
locations.blurb: Journey's end: sweet grass north of the Missouri, a cabin against the winter, calves on the range and spring branding under way. The marker is an approximate point on the Milk corridor; McMurtry names the region, not an exact ranch site.

locations.name: Where Gus Was Hit
locations.blurb: Three days north of the Yellowstone, Gus and Pea Eye are jumped by a hunting party. Two arrows strike Gus's left leg and another apparently wounds his back; Pea escapes down the flooded creek by night to bring word.

locations.name: Santa Rosa, New Mexico
locations.blurb: Where the law finally holds Blue Duck for hanging. He leaves through a third-floor window instead, taking a deputy with him, while Call watches from the street.

locations.name: Killed East of Ogallala
locations.blurb: About sixty miles east of Ogallala, soldiers find Elmira and a buffalo hunter killed by Indians after her final flight with Big Zwey. Nearby warnings make a Sioux raiding party likely, but the report does not identify the killers.
